evidence_hierarchy.submission_confirmed: original six-panel programme and centered-shape audit on main
evidence_hierarchy.post_freeze_exploratory: mechanism localization and robustness families after original outcomes were known
evidence_hierarchy.prospective_external: only analyses on response-unopened external sources under a fully frozen protocol qualify

general_rule_status: supported across multiple original bat systems; Nyctalus gives directionally robust external convergence but no successful prospective replication
strongest_general_statement: Repeatable vertical individual organization is supported across multiple bat tracking systems after coarse horizontal occupancy is standardized; in the five original comparative panels it persists in centered distribution shape.
strongest_external_statement: The first prospective Nyctalus test was directionally concordant but non-significant; post-outcome eligibility sensitivity remained positive at all seven tested session-length thresholds.
strongest_mechanism_statement: In structurally evaluable original systems, centered individuality persists beyond broad kinematic mixture, 250–500 m place matching and multi-day separation, but no single universal cause is identified.
live_mechanisms: unmeasured wing morphology or wing loading

programme_status.future_external_validation: requires a new separately frozen programme; pre-existing candidate ledger may be used without treating it as a rescue of Nyctalus
programme_status.decisive_mechanism: requires new overlap-rich field data or a new source with the needed context variables
